summary_en: KOYOSHA revised its FY2027 dividend forecast upward to 17 yen per share (from 11 yen) following the completion of a golf membership transfer expected to generate 86 million yen in special profit. The increase reflects the company's dividend policy targeting a 30% payout ratio.
summary_jp: ゴルフ会員権の譲渡完了に伴う特別利益86百万円の計上により、2027年3月期の配当予想を1株当たり17円（前回11円）に修正した。配当性向30％を目安とする基本方針に基づくもの。

summary_en: KOYOSHA raised FY2026 year-end dividend forecast from ¥7.20 to ¥10.00 per share (post-5:1 split) following better-than-expected earnings driven by carbon offset printing sales.
summary_jp: 光陽社がカーボンオフセット印刷の好調を受け、FY2026期末配当予想を7円20銭から10円に引き上げ。
